qIobaT.message: Governs journals, channel messages, the questions it asks you, and status summaries. An agent writes those, so any language works — the list only saves typing, it is not the set. Code, commit messages, branch names, PRs and error messages stay English. The orchestrator's own two dozen status lines exist in Chinese and English only; any other language falls back to English, which does not affect what the agents write. Changing this rotates every session in the fleet — it is part of the cache prefix.
qIobaT.translation: 管 journal / 频道消息 / 问你的问题 / 状态摘要。这些都是 agent 写的，所以写什么语言都行——列表只是省打字，不是能选的全部。代码、commit message、分支名、PR、错误信息永远是英文。orchestrator 自己那二十几条状态文案只有中文和英文两套，别的语言它们会退回英文——agent 写的东西不受影响。改这一项会让全舰队轮换一次 session——它在缓存前缀里。

lehVJ0.message: Host directories shared across all sandboxes, 'mount point in container: host path'. Cache package managers only. Real test: this repo, group two's bun install—no share 2.9s, shared 1.2s. Small because repo is small; monorepo sees minutes. Disabled by default because the worst incident here was all worktrees sharing node_modules; two gates install together, groups mistake EEXIST for their own broken build. Also needs that path listed in sandbox server's allowed_host_paths.
lehVJ0.translation: 所有沙盒共享的宿主目录，「容器里的挂载点: 宿主路径」。只放包管理器缓存。实测这个仓库第二个组的 bun install：不共享 2.9 秒，共享 1.2 秒——小是因为仓库小，到 monorepo 上是分钟级差别。默认关，因为这个仓库最惨的一次事故就是所有 worktree 共用一份 node_modules，两个闸门同时装，组把 EEXIST 当成自己的 build 坏了。另外沙盒服务端的 allowed_host_paths 也得列上这个路径。

OFsFwT.translation: 一条通知等多久同伴再发出去。这是「一小时一条」和「一事一条」之间的旋钮。

nQE4Jd.message: How long before a group that answered nothing is nudged again. Longer than the first wait, or the nudge becomes the noise it was meant to cut through.
nQE4Jd.translation: 一个没回应的组隔多久再催一次。要比第一次的等待更长，否则催促本身就变成了它要盖过的噪音。

-s0Ds_.message: How long before the same stuck report is worth saying again. Shorter turns one stuck group into a feed of its own.
-s0Ds_.translation: 同一条「卡住」的报告隔多久才值得再说一遍。太短会把一个卡住的组变成一条自己的信息流。

fsbkOV.message: How long one System timing report is reused before it is computed again. The report is five window-function queries over the whole span table, run synchronously, so while it computes every other request waits behind it. The data is written by a heartbeat and is never fresher than that.
fsbkOV.translation: 一份系统耗时报告在重算之前能复用多久。这份报告是对整张 span 表跑五个窗口函数查询，同步执行——算的时候其他请求都排在后面。数据本来就由心跳写入，不会比心跳更新。

zAEv6-.message: How long one turn may run, and how much it may read
zAEv6-.translation: 一个 turn 能跑多久，能读多少

drSXY4.message: How long the POST above may take. The answer is discarded either way—this only stops a webhook that never replies from holding a notification.
drSXY4.translation: 上面那个 POST 最多花多久。答案反正会丢掉——这只是别让一个不回话的 webhook 卡住通知。

qnORSK.message: How long the usage endpoint is left alone once it has refused. Shorter than the refusal lasts and the poll simply keeps earning fresh ones.
qnORSK.translation: 用量接口被拒之后晾多久。比拒绝持续的时间还短，轮询就只是不停地再挨一次拒绝。

zkIDNY.message: How many live frames may queue for one slow browser tab before frames are dropped. Up to four concurrent turns push one frame per token, so a tab that stopped reading is the one case that grows without bound. Dropping is safe—the panel re-reads its state on the next event—and the loss is counted rather than silent.
zkIDNY.translation: 一个慢的浏览器标签页最多能积多少帧才开始丢。最多四个并发 turn，每个 token 推一帧，所以停止读取的标签页是唯一会无界增长的情况。丢帧是安全的——下一个事件到来时面板会重读状态——而且丢了多少是记下来的，不是悄悄的。

p4BjUG.message: How many nodes the model may name at one level. Width costs tokens in a single call, where depth costs another call.
p4BjUG.translation: 模型在一层里最多能点名多少个节点。宽度花的是一次调用里的 token，深度花的是又一次调用。

FTfUw0.message: How many open pull requests one poll asks GitHub about. Node counts are what a GraphQL query costs, so every number in this group is a ceiling bought with quota.
FTfUw0.translation: 一次轮询向 GitHub 问多少个开着的 PR。GraphQL 查询的开销就是节点数，所以这一组里每个数字都是拿配额买来的上限。

N89lXv.message: How much runs at once, and when work moves on without you
N89lXv.translation: 同时跑多少，以及什么时候不等你就往下走

Axfmw8.message: How often deterministic rules run. Also how long queued work waits without an explicit tick before dispatch.
Axfmw8.translation: 确定性规则多久跑一遍。也是没有显式 tick 的入队要等多久才被派发。

rWXzDL.message: How often the shared repository map is even checked. A container round trip cost 947ms of every 30s tick, over 2,766 ticks, to answer 'unchanged' about a map whose only input is a push — so this is deliberately far longer than the tick.
rWXzDL.translation: 共享仓库地图多久才检查一次。每 30 秒的 tick 里有一次容器往返花掉 947ms，跑了 2,766 次，只为回答一句「没变」——而这张地图的唯一输入是一次 push，所以这个值故意比 tick 长得多。

OIuB5D.context: a picture, not a container image

a8ydNj.message: Is the sandbox server up, and does it take our key. Usually loopback, and its answer only fills in a report—where the network ping below gates the whole fleet.
a8ydNj.translation: 沙盒服务器在不在，认不认我们的密钥。通常是回环，而且它的答案只是填一份报告——下面那个网络探测才卡着整个 fleet。

8O_fJP.message: Is there a network at all: a HEAD to every provider origin, run inside the watchdog tick. Deliberately the shortest wait here—a slow answer must not hold a tick open.
8O_fJP.translation: 到底有没有网：对每个供应商 origin 发一个 HEAD，在 watchdog 的 tick 里跑。这里故意最短——答案慢不能把一个 tick 拖住。

sOqJT5.message: It's not a duplicate, and it's not done yet — keep decomposing.
sOqJT5.translation: 不是重复，也不算已经做完了 —— 接着拆。

sN5SzN.message: Just describe what you need. A plan card will be generated for approval before any code is written.
sN5SzN.translation: 说清要什么就够。产出计划卡待批，批准前不写代码。

XonalD.message: Let bootstrap retry; it will review the repository with the error above in context
XonalD.translation: 交给 bootstrap 重试，它会带着上面的报错读一遍仓库

UO8Jaq.message: Levels of the tree one question may descend, and each level is a serial model call with its own 60s timeout — two per question at 3. This is the single knob on the most frequent model spend here.
UO8Jaq.translation: 一个问题最多往树下走几层，每一层都是一次串行的模型调用，各带 60 秒超时——深度 3 时一个问题两次。这是这里最频繁的模型开销上唯一的旋钮。

EQID1f.message: Line-level review threads per pull request. A hundred threads read through a window of twenty means the eighty oldest are never seen, and that ceiling is a property of the repository being watched rather than of the watcher.
EQID1f.translation: 每个 PR 读多少条行级审阅线程。一百条线程用二十的窗口去读，最旧的八十条永远看不到；而这个上限是被观察的仓库的性质，不是观察者的。

rBmsAu.translation: 本地在这台机器上算，远程发到你指定的地址。目前两者都还没用于检索——实测跨语言搜索比它要替代的关键词搜索更差。远程意味着你的需求和验收标准会离开这台机器，所以默认本地，用远程是个决定。
rBmsAu.message: Local runs on this machine; remote sends text to an endpoint you choose. Neither is used for retrieval yet — measured, cross-language search was worse than the keyword search it would replace. Remote means your requirements and acceptance criteria leave this machine, so local is the default and remote is a decision.

mTyZmU.message: Local to this machine only, not tied to the project
mTyZmU.translation: 只在这台机器上，不跟着项目走

gmtnyc.message: Log in within the container; no need to install codex locally
gmtnyc.translation: 在容器里登录，本机不用装 codex

g9KxkF.message: Logs are stored in server memory, max 500 lines, cleared on restart. The conclusion is in "Notes".
g9KxkF.translation: 日志在服务端内存里，最多 500 行，重启就没了。结论那条在「记录」里。

PeDZSK.message: Max channel messages to cram into one delta per turn.
PeDZSK.translation: 一轮最多把多少条频道消息塞进 delta。

gaMZOo.message: Name a stored credential and remote retrieval switches on.
gaMZOo.translation: 填一个已存的凭据名，远程检索就会打开。

ULmBuU.message: Name can't be empty; use the × on the right to delete
ULmBuU.translation: 名字不能空着，要删就按右边的 ×

d1fjbO.message: New files are expected; if it thinks these already exist, the card was written from speculation.
d1fjbO.translation: 新建的文件正常；如果它以为这些已经存在，这张卡是照着想象写的。

6Vgn9k.message: New projects use this; leave blank to follow config
6Vgn9k.translation: 新项目默认用它，留空跟配置文件

pr2q9d.message: No boundaries drawn yet. The Architect decides which paths each group may write before work starts; groups without one run into the same files.
pr2q9d.translation: 还没有划过边界。Architect 开工前划定每组能写哪些路径，没划的组并行会踩到同一批文件。

2BdXR9.message: No deliveries yet. Requirements are archived here after merging to main.
2BdXR9.translation: 还没有交付过。合入 main 之后的需求归档到这里。

kRwdtK.message: No diff available. The slice didn't record a baseline commit, or the sandbox has been reclaimed.
kRwdtK.translation: 没有 diff 可读。这一片没有记下基线 commit，或者沙盒已经回收了。

112a8L.message: No gates enabled; LLM review has no floor.
112a8L.translation: 一道都没开，LLM 审阅底下就没有地板。

pkh1lU.message: No notes yet. Agents write journals each turn; retrospectives are written before the group dissolves and distilled into lessons for later groups.
pkh1lU.translation: 还没有记录。agent 每个 turn 写 journal，组解散前写 retro，retro 归纳成教训注入后续组。

7NntGT.message: No one working yet. Approve a plan card and each agent's current task appears here.
7NntGT.translation: 还没有人上工。批准一张计划卡，这里就会列出每个 agent 在做什么。

Owb59A.message: No open questions. This group is not waiting on you right now.
Owb59A.translation: 没有开着的问题。这一组的人现在不等你。

8UMyhm.message: No other models yet; just type
8UMyhm.translation: 还没有别的模型，直接写就行

FyCSgf.message: No other requirements for this project
FyCSgf.translation: 这个项目没有别的需求

FCR3S_.message: No paused requirements. Groups pause here when budget is exhausted or waiting for your answer exceeds 2 hours; work is kept.
FCR3S_.translation: 没有停着的需求。预算用尽、或等你答问题超过 2 小时会封存到这里，工作不丢。

u1OZfk.message: No requirements in progress. Click + for a new one in the top right.
u1OZfk.translation: 没有在办的需求。右上角 ＋ 新需求。

D8lG5Z.translation: 还没有记下任何系统活动。

A2To5D.message: No tokens spent yet. After approving plan cards, costs break down by requirement per agent. Tier tag determines which model.
A2To5D.translation: 还没花 token。批准计划卡之后，这里按需求往下拆到每个 agent。难度标签决定跑哪个模型。

e9k3F8.message: None; this connection sees no repositories. Install with all repos, or select specific ones.
e9k3F8.translation: 一个也没有，这个连接看不见任何仓库。装的时候选所有仓库，或者挑几个。

qB4FXu.message: Not enough data for two hours.
qB4FXu.translation: 还不够两个小时的数据。

QEXVOr.message: Not enough data for two periods.
QEXVOr.translation: 还不够两个时段的数据。

nw77tA.message: Not local, not on an encrypted network—traffic is unencrypted HTTP. Keys and container traffic are exposed; use HTTPS or Tailscale.
nw77tA.translation: 不在本机，也不在加密内网，走的还是明文 http。密钥和容器流量都是裸的，用 https 或者 Tailscale。

pJLF3J.message: Not started yet; waiting for prior slices to be accepted.
pJLF3J.translation: 还没开工，等前面的切片查收。

Z2qRB3.message: Nothing on GitHub changes: the branches are there, the PRs are there, not a line of code is touched. What is removed is this machine's copy of the work.
Z2qRB3.translation: GitHub 上什么都不动：分支还在，PR 还在，代码一行不少。移除的只是这台机器上的这份工作。

0LY7RL.message: On, a question walks the PageIndex tree before it is answered. Off skips the walk before the tree is even loaded, so the query costs no model call and falls through to the lexical half — which is the A/B this switch exists for. Its own switch rather than a depth of 0, which still walks, degenerately.
0LY7RL.translation: 打开时，一个问题先走一遍 PageIndex 树再回答。关掉则在加载树之前就跳过，于是这次查询不花模型调用，落到字面检索那一半——这正是这个开关存在的 A/B。做成独立开关而不是深度 0，因为深度 0 仍然会走，只是退化地走。

u3JJbf.message: Once boundaries are cleared, work starts automatically; no need to click again.
u3JJbf.translation: 让开之后自动开工，不用再点一次

NS_SrO.message: One branch name per line, most likely first
NS_SrO.translation: 一行一个分支名，最可能的写在前面

0-_m6g.message: One CI run can post fifty of these. Set below what your workflow produces and the fleet decides a pull request is green while a check it never saw is red.
0-_m6g.translation: 一次 CI 就能发五十条。设得比你的 workflow 产出还低，fleet 就会认定一个 PR 是绿的，而它没看见的那条检查是红的。

oyPQFp.message: One domain per line; empty allows all
oyPQFp.translation: 一行一个域名，留空就都放行

U0Bgc_.message: One operation that moves a repository or an image across the network—a clone, a fetch, a submodule init, the sandbox SDK's own per-request budget. Minutes rather than seconds: the worst case is an image pull, which is the same shape of wait as a clone.
U0Bgc_.translation: 一次把仓库或镜像搬过网络的操作——克隆、拉取、submodule init，以及沙盒 SDK 自己的单次请求预算。是分钟不是秒：最坏情况是拉镜像，那和克隆是同一种等待。

QPXgDJ.message: One REST call whose answer is work somebody asked for—opening a pull request, reading a review. Longer than the credential check below because something is blocked on it.
QPXgDJ.translation: 一次 REST 调用，它的答案就是某人要的活——开 PR、读审阅。比下面的凭据检查长，因为有东西被它卡着。

b75mRc.message: One unanswered notification is repeated on this ladder: the first repeat waits the first step, then the second, and it holds at the last step for as long as nobody answers. At least one step—an empty ladder means 'repeat every tick'.
b75mRc.translation: 一条没人回的通知按这个阶梯重复：第一次重复等第一级，然后第二级，到最后一级就一直停在那里，直到有人回。至少要有一级——空阶梯的意思是「每个 tick 都重复」。

8YP-N2.message: Only two sources: our releases (ghcr.io/pamin-labs/…) and local builds without registry prefix. Agents run here with your code—swap in an untrusted image and you've handed the boundary to someone else, invisibly from the panel.
8YP-N2.translation: 只认两个来源：我们发布的 ghcr.io/pamin-labs/…，和没有 registry 前缀的本机 build。这里面跑的是 agent，而 agent 手里有你的代码——换一个来路不明的镜像就是把整条边界交给别人，而且从面板上看不出任何异常。

GIvsjD.translation: 粘贴进来，存下之后看不到

Yj_Oy0.message: Pick a model to add a row

u8jL5T.translation: 每次轮询的 PR 数

9KFZ12.message: Rate limited reading usage; it recovers by itself shortly
9KFZ12.translation: 读用量被限流了，过一会自己恢复

ozwmb2.message: Read from the sandbox server's own config (OPENSANDBOX_CONFIG, ./sandbox.toml, ~/.sandbox.toml). Values don't pass through the browser.
ozwmb2.translation: 从沙盒服务器自己的配置里读（OPENSANDBOX_CONFIG、./sandbox.toml、~/.sandbox.toml）。值不经过浏览器。

SDCu3f.message: Reading how much of the subscription window is left, curl'd from the utility container. Nothing is blocked on it; the header simply shows no percentage.
SDCu3f.translation: 读订阅窗口还剩多少，从工具容器里 curl。没有东西等它；顶栏只是不显示百分比而已。

Z1GEoV.message: Real data: 259 turns, median 36 steps, p90 93, max 144. The 23% over 60 steps ate 59% of the cache-read bill, because every step re-reads the full transcript. 36 is work; the tail is an agent lost, grepping. Cut the tail, median doesn't move. Changing this rotates the whole fleet through a session.
Z1GEoV.translation: 实测 259 个真实 turn：中位数 36 步，p90 是 93，最大 144——而超过 60 步的那 23% 吃掉了整个 cache-read 账单的 59%，因为每一步都要重读整条 transcript。36 是活儿，尾巴是一个已经迷路、正在 grep 的 agent。砍尾巴不动中位数。改这一项会让全舰队轮换一次 session。

A16Eqd.message: Real tokens don't enter the sandbox

iGlRgg.message: Release the concurrency slot; code and checkpoint in the sandbox stay in place.
iGlRgg.translation: 释放并发槽，沙盒里的代码和 checkpoint 原地不动

Dkm2X3.message: Renewed when a turn starts, so this is 'recover after idle', not 'task time limit'.
Dkm2X3.translation: turn 开始时会续期，所以这是「没人管了多久回收」，不是任务时长上限。

ORouxy.message: Reply. Sending this will unblock the waiting agent. Cmd+Enter to send
ORouxy.translation: 答复。发出去直接解开被阻塞的 agent。⌘Enter 发送

2R0JRN.message: Repos with DCO enabled won't accept commits without this line
2R0JRN.translation: 开了 DCO 的仓库不收没有这行的提交

LRRbF6.message: Reset to the image in config

qxbfmr.message: Restarted {cold} times across {turns} turns: {why}. Each restart rebuilds the cache prefix from scratch
qxbfmr.translation: {turns} 个 turn 里重开了 {cold} 次：{why}。重开一次，缓存前缀要从头建一遍

vAZ1vN.message: Restarted; containers will restart on demand
vAZ1vN.translation: 重启了，容器会按需重开

Dn1cWK.message: Return to the checkpoint before this round started; all changes in this turn are discarded.
Dn1cWK.translation: 回到这一轮开始前的 checkpoint，这个 turn 的改动全丢

CDes-i.message: Roll back to the checkpoint when the question was asked; all subsequent changes are discarded. You'll answer it again.
CDes-i.translation: 回滚到提问时的 checkpoint，之后的改动作废，由你重新回答。

F7ezNA.message: Roughly 4k token. This answer lands in the transcript, and every remaining turn in the session re-reads it—so a generous answer keeps billing long after the question is answered.
F7ezNA.translation: 约等于 4k token。这个答案会落进 transcript，而 transcript 这个会话剩下的每一轮都要重读一遍——所以慷慨的答案在问题被回答完很久之后还在收费。

yar4DV.message: Run claude setup-token in the container

sRVwZe.message: Run the official CLI's login once in the tool container; store the credential here. No setup needed locally. Official accounts only; custom gateways use API key.
sRVwZe.translation: 在工具容器里跑一次官方 CLI 的登录，拿到的凭据存在这儿。本机什么都不用装。仅限官方账号；自建网关走 API key。

siNdHG.translation: 从上往下跑，拖着改顺序

EbMFqt.message: Running, but we can't control it

pOVGLp.message: Running, not started by us; using as-is
pOVGLp.translation: 在跑，不是我们起的，直接用

gkL2ub.message: Same magnitude as lease, same category—real compilation. Too tight fails like 'this project is broken' not 'timeout', and groups get stuck either way.
gkL2ub.translation: 和 lease 同一个量级，因为是同一类东西——真的在编译。卡太紧的失败长得像「这个项目坏了」而不像「超时了」，而组在两种情况下都一样卡住。

zkYz4A.message: Send the entire requirement back to Dispatcher for a deeper dive; code already written stays on the branch.
zkYz4A.translation: 整个需求退回 Dispatcher 重新深挖，已写的代码留在分支上

GD78ah.message: Send the entire requirement back to Dispatcher for a deeper dive; this comment is the highest-priority fact.
GD78ah.translation: 整条需求退回 Dispatcher 重新深挖，这句话作为最高优先级 fact

Ufp8L2.message: Set a token limit for this requirement
Ufp8L2.translation: 给这个需求设 token 上限

P14X5y.message: Settings: account, environment, skills, theme, and this project's gates and sandbox ⌘S
P14X5y.translation: 设置：账号、环境、技能、主题，以及这个项目的闸门和沙盒 ⌘S

M8DQJW.message: Silence this long and the group is asked what it is doing. Not a failure — a long compile is silent too — so this is hours rather than minutes.
M8DQJW.translation: 沉默这么久，就会去问这个组在干什么。不是失败——编译很久也是沉默的——所以这里是小时而不是分钟。

7YvQJV.message: Slice baseline was lost in rebase; showing the entire branch relative to origin/main
7YvQJV.translation: 切片基线被 rebase 冲掉了，这里是整条分支相对 origin/main 的改动

HXfn_B.message: Spent {spent} tokens against a {cap} limit. Only raising the limit moves it — "resume" does nothing.
HXfn_B.translation: 已花 {spent} tokens，上限 {cap}。加上限才动得了，「继续」不生效。

i-G7HL.message: Stop dispatching; branch is kept but not merged. A retrospective is still required.
i-G7HL.translation: 停止派发，分支保留不合入，仍然要写 retro

Js8gEk.message: Stop the current turn; keep changes. The next turn will be informed.
Js8gEk.translation: 停止当前 turn，改动留着，下一个 turn 会被告知

2UUIn6.message: Swap sessions when context hits this much of the window. Fallback trigger; real rotation is slice-end—clean semantic boundary, cheap handoff.
2UUIn6.translation: 上下文用到窗口的这么多就换一个会话。兜底触发器，真正的轮换点是切片做完——那是个干净的语义边界，交接也便宜。

22d3SP.message: The browser can't read this. Drag folders in instead.
22d3SP.translation: 浏览器读不到这些内容。文件夹得拖进来。

KL0N71.message: The chosen skill is sent with this turn; it only costs for this one turn.
KL0N71.translation: 选中的技能，正文随这一个 turn 发给 agent，只花这一次钱

clowMB.message: The codex refresh-token exchange, run inside the utility container. Longer than the usage read because it is a process start plus an OAuth round trip, where that one wraps a curl already carrying its own limit.
clowMB.translation: codex 的 refresh token 交换，在工具容器里跑。比用量读取长，因为它是启动一个进程加一次 OAuth 往返，而那边包的是一条自带超时的 curl。

cu7PMH.message: The conversation—what was said, asked and escalated—is never dropped: it is the record, and the unread cursor walks it. This bounds the rest, which the cost view reads inside a day and then never again.
cu7PMH.translation: 对话——说过的、问过的、升级过的——永远不删：它就是记录，未读游标要走它。这个值管的是其余部分，成本视图当天读一次，之后再也不读。

oToTQd.message: The denominator for session rotation. Both CLI agents report real values in a turn, and that takes priority; this table manages the first turn of a session. When we pinned 200k, strong models rotated constantly in the 12% of a 1M window, discarding built-up cache prefix each time.
oToTQd.translation: 轮换 session 的分母。两个 CLI 在 turn 里都会报真实值，那个值优先；这张表管的是一个 session 的第一个 turn。写死成 200k 的那阵子，强模型一直在 1M 窗口的 12% 处轮换，每轮换一次就扔掉一次花钱建起来的缓存前缀。

Bn1Nxe.message: The entire requirement returns to Dispatcher for a deeper dive; this comment is the highest-priority fact.
Bn1Nxe.translation: 整个需求退回 Dispatcher 重新深挖，这句话作为最高优先级 fact。

DJSa8p.message: The first ceiling usually isn't this: two groups can't own overlapping paths, so low-modularity projects can't reach 10; then account-level rate limits. Raising this, watch cache hit rate on the cost page—high concurrency on one subscription throttles there first.
DJSa8p.translation: 先撞上的天花板通常不是这个数：两个组不能拥有重叠路径，所以可分的模块少的项目达不到 10；再就是账号自己的限流。调高了记得看成本页的 cache 命中率——同一个订阅上并发多，节流最先在那里现形。

pJvSbD.message: The last step repeats for as long as nobody answers
pJvSbD.translation: 最后一级会一直重复，直到有人回

lWz20C.message: The name of a row under Model account, never the key
lWz20C.translation: 「模型账号」里那一行的名字，不是密钥本身

tJoWaz.message: The name of that line in 'Model account', not the key itself. Key in config is key in shell history and every backup.
tJoWaz.translation: 「模型账号」里那一行的名字，不是密钥本身。密钥写进配置文件就等于写进 shell 历史和它的每一份备份里。

3pCONH.message: The other half of stuck: the same file rewritten this many times running. An agent converging touches its neighbours; an agent stuck rewrites one file until the budget is gone.
3pCONH.translation: 「卡住」的另一半：同一个文件连着被重写这么多次。在收敛的 agent 会碰到邻近的文件；卡住的 agent 会一直重写一个文件，直到预算烧完。

jFIXsB.message: The single most-called model call across the whole system: pure summarization, no decision-making, no tools, no blackboard. First thing to move off a premium subscription.
jFIXsB.translation: 全系统调用最频繁的一个模型调用：纯摘要、不做决策、不用工具、不碰黑板。第一个该从贵订阅上挪走的就是它。

2ipr2S.message: The usage endpoint is undocumented and answers a faster poller with 429 for hours—and your own /status spends from the same budget. Ten minutes inside a five-hour window is a 3% error at worst.
2ipr2S.translation: 用量接口没有文档，轮得快了就连着几小时回 429——而你自己的 /status 花的是同一份额度。五小时窗口里十分钟一次，最坏也就 3% 的误差。

Ez2cT0.message: These paths from the card don't exist in the repo
Ez2cT0.translation: 卡里这些路径仓库里没有

50AYjp.message: This comment becomes the highest-priority fact; the entire requirement returns to Dispatcher for a deeper dive. Code stays on the branch.
50AYjp.translation: 这句话作为最高优先级 fact，整个需求退回 Dispatcher 重新深挖。已写的代码留在分支上。

UVazM1.message: This many turns in a row that changed nothing is what the watchdog calls stuck. Below three it fires on an agent that is reading before it writes; well above it, a loop runs all afternoon before anybody hears about it.
UVazM1.translation: 连着这么多个 turn 什么都没改，watchdog 就叫它卡住。低于 3 会误伤先读后写的 agent；高很多，一个死循环能跑一下午才有人知道。

tERiuN.message: This process wasn't started by us—it might be something you're using. Restart it yourself if needed; we'll recognize it afterward.
tERiuN.translation: 这个进程不是我们起的，可能是你自己在用的那个。要重启就自己重启，之后这里会认得它。

Ap7MoR.message: This project hasn't run any activity yet.
Ap7MoR.translation: 这个项目还没跑过任何活。

_BU99I.message: This requirement has been archived or no longer exists.
_BU99I.translation: 这个需求已经归档或不存在了。

OqyUgx.message: This requirement hasn't run any activity yet.
OqyUgx.translation: 这个需求还没跑过任何活。

QzBCQU.message: This slice hasn't produced changes yet and has no verdict.
QzBCQU.translation: 这一片还没跑出改动，也还没有判词。

rTvIpI.message: This window needs {count} buckets, more than fits
rTvIpI.translation: 这段时间要 {count} 格，画不下

TtMxW4.message: Timing for all activity on this machine, last 24h
TtMxW4.translation: 这台机器上所有活动的耗时，最近一天

Ms3Kz5.translation: 按顺序试，只在别的都没答话时才用：项目自己的基线分支优先，然后是 GitHub 的 default_branch。远端连不上时就落到这里。
Ms3Kz5.message: Tried in order, and only when nothing else answered: a project's own base branch wins, then GitHub's default_branch. This is what a repository falls back to when its remote cannot be reached.

3IqNQS.message: Turned off, but page alerts and tab title counts still work—just no pop-ups.
3IqNQS.translation: 关掉之后仍然会在页面里提示，标签页标题也照样带计数——只是不再弹出窗口。

7VgwUn.message: Type a model ID to add a row
7VgwUn.translation: 填个模型 id 就多一行

y3j75X.message: Under {account}, this App can see no repository at all. It may have been installed with only a few ticked.
y3j75X.translation: {account} 下面，这个 App 一个仓库都看不到。装的时候可能只勾了几个。

Qd3NOV.message: Use 'defer' to archive without deleting; that keeps records
Qd3NOV.translation: 想留下记录就用「不做了」封存，那个不删

BVhEN_.message: Use this only if you can't reopen an old PR on GitHub. Use when the branch has been force-pushed or deleted: it will re-open using the current branch and rejoin the merge queue.
BVhEN_.translation: 能在 GitHub 上重开旧 PR 就不用这个。分支被强推或删过才用：会用当前分支重提一个，回到合入队列。

5SUvzT.message: Use when the container is stuck, missing dependencies, or credentials changed. The next turn will re-clone and reinstall; the branch in the host repo stays.
5SUvzT.translation: 容器卡住、少挂了东西、或换过凭据时用。下一个 turn 重新 clone + 装依赖，分支在宿主仓库里不会丢

i4-1iz.message: Used when a project has not set its own
i4-1iz.translation: 没自己设的项目用这些

OxAtzf.message: Waiting for you to approve in the browser…

cdTn1o.message: Waiting for you to approve on GitHub…
cdTn1o.translation: 等你在 GitHub 上批准…

WFKlDQ.message: Waits on the world outside, and what this machine keeps
WFKlDQ.translation: 对外面世界的等待，以及这台机器留下什么

5dkBFM.message: Wants a duration: 20 min, 45s, 3 hr all work
5dkBFM.translation: 要一个时长：20 分钟、45s、3 小时都行

X7LT6N.message: Wants a duration: 24 hr, 30 min both work
X7LT6N.translation: 要一个时长：24 小时、30 分钟都行

vEanQX.message: Wants a percentage between 0 and 100, like 60%
vEanQX.translation: 要 0 到 100 之间的百分比，比如 60%

d8ExK5.message: Was connected, but GitHub no longer recognizes this token
d8ExK5.translation: 连过，但 GitHub 现在不认这个令牌了

2JOwRq.message: What this browser reads. What the agents write is the output language, under Models & budget — and this follows it unless you pick one here.
2JOwRq.translation: 这台机器读什么语言。agent 写什么语言是「对外语言」，在 模型与预算 里——没在这里单独选的话，这里就跟着它走。

oM0GrX.message: What's not satisfactory. Cmd+Enter to reject

Wv9_yD.message: When the limit is reached, the group pauses until you decide whether to increase it.
Wv9_yD.translation: 用满就挂起，等你决定加不加。

1IcqqV.message: When the same thing surfaces N times, it should be a project rule, not the N+1-th complaint.
1IcqqV.translation: 同一件事说到第 N 次，它就该是项目的一条规则，而不是第 N+1 次抱怨。

EM-n9s.message: Where opensandbox-server lives. Must be dns+nft mode or credential injection silently fails. Doesn't have to be this machine—Tailscale peer or cloud machine, SDK only talks HTTP.
EM-n9s.translation: opensandbox-server 在哪。必须是 dns+nft 模式，否则凭据注入静默失效。它不一定在这台机器上——Tailscale 上的一台或者一台云机器都行，SDK 只跟它说 HTTP。

A73faa.message: Which model runs what, and what it may spend
A73faa.translation: 哪个模型跑什么，能花多少

6R0Qtt.message: Will be read at the start of the next turn. Paste screenshots directly; / to insert a skill. Cmd+Enter to send to PM
6R0Qtt.translation: 下一个 turn 开头就会读到。截图直接粘，/ 插技能路径。⌘Enter 发给 PM

sAMeNl.message: Write a description, break into plan cards, then come back for review.
sAMeNl.translation: 写一句话，拆成计划卡再回来给你批。

pO1sKo.message: Write the full /v1/embeddings address and remote retrieval switches on.
pO1sKo.translation: 写完整的 /v1/embeddings 地址，远程检索就会打开。

d0a7Yx.message: You can edit the card and re-approve.
